latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Major update: Meal skill revamped for business catering management.

- Shifted from personal meal planning to comprehensive enterprise business meal management.
- Added support for business/working meals, hosting, meal requests, compliance checks, and order/approval tracking.
- Enforced mandatory fields, policy compliance, approval requirements, and duplicate order checks.
- Introduced city and job-level meal standard tables, multi-scenario support, and invoice/reimbursement management.
- Defined API interfaces, input/output formats, and sample display templates for restaurant selection, orders, and compliance.
- All documentation and prompts provided in Chinese for enterprise users.
